title: murmuring
author: blaastaal
transformations: Downloaded public high-quality MP3 preview of the CC0 quiet-people field recording, cropped seconds 30–51.5, downmixed mono, high-pass 100 Hz / low-pass 1700 Hz, 1.5-second equal-power wrap crossfade yields 20-second loop, peak normalized to −4.01 dBFS.

title: A Small Fire Will Do (Calming Loop)
author: Cal McEachern (Trex0n)
transformations: Published acoustic-guitar music; cropped seconds 16–32.2, downmixed mono, high-pass 65 Hz / low-pass 6500 Hz, 200 ms equal-power wrap crossfade yields 16-second loop, peak normalized to −4.01 dBFS. Source does not specify live versus sampled instrumentation.

title: Battle Theme
author: Wolfgang_ / Theodore Kerr
transformations: Published orchestral battle music; cropped seconds 16–61.5, downmixed mono, high-pass 45 Hz, 1.5-second equal-power wrap crossfade yields 44-second loop, normalized to −4.44 dBFS before encoding MP3 mono 128 kbps. Source does not specify live versus sampled instrumentation.

title: Interface Sounds — glass_004.ogg
author: Kenney
transformations: Three layered copies of glass_004 at 1.0×, 1.25×, and 1.5× pitch, staggered by 180 ms, quiet 140 ms reflection, 35 ms edge fades, mono PCM16 44.1 kHz, peak normalized to −3.35 dBFS. No generated tones.
